title: 菊花賞の後に・人生のステイヤー

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Claiming victory at the Kikuka Sho, Mejiro McQueen's dominance at long-distance races is indisputable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan expresses her frustration at their difference in ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In response, McQueen tells Ryan that she hopes to see her best effort in the final furlong of their next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Kikuka Sho over, our next race is the Arima Kinen. Mejiro Ryan must now prepare for a race where many new, strong opponents await.
